_doc: Who restarts Crissa's own lanes when they go down (lib/crissa_watch.py, the launcher scripts/crissa.py, 2026-10-06). Later wins: this file, then <crissa home>/watch.json. Every restart is logged with its reason in <crissa home>/logs/lanes.log and shown on the Control Panel (<crissa home>/lanes.json).
closable_why: a lane the person may close on purpose (2026-10-10): restarted only when it crashed; a close (Ctrl+Q, Close the Wall, its unit stopped) holds until Open the Wall (lib/crissa_watch CLOSED)
